newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-UNITED POISED TO SIGN BRAZIL'S CELIO SILVA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNITED POISED TO SIGN BRAZIL'S CELIO SILVA.

text.p: English champions Manchester United were poised to sign Brazilian international defender Celio Silva on Monday.
The club said it had agreed a transfer fee with the defender's present Brazilian side Corinthians and United officials were talking to the player about personal terms in Manchester on Monday.
The fee is believed to be around 3.5 million pounds ($5.9 million).
In addition to his defensive abilities, the 29-year-old Silva has a reputation for having one of the most powerful shots in the game.
United manager Alex Ferguson has been keen to buy an experienced defender for some time and recently tried to bring Bayern Munich's German international Markus Babbel to Old Trafford.
Silva will become Ferguson's second major signing of the close season after he bought England striker Teddy Sheringham from Tottenham last month as a replacement for retired Frenchman Eric Cantona.
